##### Project general facts

Creek Waters is a high-rise residential development in Dubai Creek Harbour, combining contemporary architecture with innovative landscaping and waterfront views. Inspired by Dubai Creek’s historic role as a trading route and an important part of the city’s heritage, the towers are designed to reflect the surrounding water and natural landscape. The project offers an upscale residential experience in one of Dubai Creek Harbour’s emerging urban districts.

The development combines modern residential living with landscaped outdoor spaces and views of Dubai Creek. Its amenities podium provides direct access to retail shops, restaurants, and cafés, while the surrounding promenade offers additional opportunities for shopping, dining, and leisure.

The residences feature contemporary interiors with carefully selected materials, fittings, and finishes designed for modern city living. The kitchens are unequipped, and the residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to customise their spaces to their preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Creek Waters is located in Dubai Creek Harbour, a modern, pedestrian-friendly waterfront community that integrates residential, retail, business, and recreational spaces. The wider master development covers approximately 7.4 million square metres of residential space and includes around 500,000 square metres of parks and open spaces.

The surrounding district is planned to offer a range of everyday conveniences, including schools, lifestyle and entertainment destinations, retail shops, restaurants, and cafés. The waterfront promenade provides further shopping and leisure options, while the community’s walkable layout brings many amenities within convenient reach.

Dubai Creek Harbour offers access to transport routes connecting the area with the rest of Dubai. Its combination of waterfront surroundings, open spaces, and mixed-use facilities creates a contemporary urban environment with an emphasis on walkability and sustainable city living.
